focus: methodological (simulated/measured/mocker/real-GPU) + numeric re-check against corrected provenance store and collector_artifacts source

summary.note: No methodological overclaim of the 'ran on real silicon' type found. The chapter is careful: the encoder cost model IS real RTX-5090 silicon (phaseE / phaseA/B collector artifacts); the validation measurements (tab:aic-validation, tab:aic-fn HF-eager, and the vLLM forward) ARE real RTX-5090 measurements on synthetic inputs (line 327 discloses 'forward compute on synthetic inputs, not the complete serving path'); the two-pool test and the winsched reprice ARE explicitly labeled simulation (dynamo.replay offline, FIFO queue). The h100_sxm language-pool timing is described as AIC engine timing / a real Azure trace, never as real-H100 inference. Prior pass's two flagged 'inconsistencies' both resolve as correct.

methodology_axis.validation_measurements: REAL RTX-5090, HuggingFace-transformers eager (SDPA backend) forward, CUDA events, 5x50, locked clocks. Confirmed phaseA_validation/result.txt + collector_fn.measured/measured_5x50.
methodology_axis.vllm_forward: REAL RTX-5090, standalone eager forward through vLLM's own Qwen3-VL vision tower, synthetic inputs. Confirmed collector_encoder_fn engine='vllm' (attn=FLASH_ATTN), 69 batch sizes N=1..512, max CI95=0.0581ms.
methodology_axis.two_pool_smoke: SIMULATION. dynamo.replay --replay-mode offline --router-mode kv_router --num-workers 2; encoder = FIFO sim priced from AIC on rtx_5090 silicon. Confirmed collector_artifacts/phase9_two_pool/{run.sh,encoder_pool_sim.py,two_pool_report.json}.
methodology_axis.winsched_reprice_606ms: SIMULATION (schedule replay), encoder repriced with the REAL vLLM f(N). p99 606ms is a queued-sim result, not hardware. Confirmed collector_encoder_stats winsched_treatment_vllm=605.6 / ctrl_aic=589.3, queue_divergent=false.
